properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable SSL support for the dev service.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.pem.keystore.certificate
properties.description: Location or content of the certificate or certificate chain in PEM format.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.pem.keystore.private-key
properties.description: Location or content of the private key in PEM format.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.pem.keystore.private-key-password
properties.description: Password used to decrypt an encrypted private key.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.pem.key.alias
properties.description: The alias that identifies the key in the key store.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.pem.key.password
properties.description: The password used to access the key in the key store.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.jks.keystore.type
properties.description: Type of the store to create, e.g. JKS.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.jks.keystore.location
properties.description: Location of the resource containing the store content.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.jks.keystore.password
properties.description: Password used to access the store.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.jks.key.alias
properties.description: The alias that identifies the key in the key store.

properties.name: arconia.dev.services.rabbitmq.ssl.jks.key.password
properties.description: The password used to access the key in the key store.
